title: I Got Tired of Coming into my Lab to Check the Pressure of my Cryocooler so I Built a Tool to do it for Me
why_read: A fun, grounded hardware/software hack for monitoring lab equipment remotely, a relatable real-world engineering story even if narrow in scope.
analysis: The author built a custom PCB voltmeter and monitoring tool to remotely track cryocooler vacuum pressure instead of manually checking a multimeter in person. It's a nice example of applied embedded systems and DIY instrumentation solving a real lab workflow problem. The technical content is modest in scope, mostly PCB design plus basic data logging, but it's a genuine, well-told engineering story with hands-on hardware detail.
